about: Reply-door, caller-signal, redaction and compile-lint rules as data. The TypeScript door (product/shared/safety/index.ts) and the Python door (product/voice) load this one file and are held to cases.json. Rules are evaluated in array order; the first reply rule that fires decides. Industry-neutral rules have scope.packs absent; sector rules name their pack.

regex.dialect: Common subset of ECMAScript (flags 'iu') and Python re (flags re.I). No named groups, no \p{...}, no variable-width lookbehind. \b is used only next to Latin letters. Patterns run on the NORMALISED text.
normalise: remove zero-width characters U+200B U+200C U+200D U+FEFF
chandrabindu U+0901 -> anusvara U+0902; nukta U+093C removed
runs of whitespace -> one space, trimmed
PATTERNS get the same Devanagari folding (NFC, nukta removed, chandrabindu -> anusvara) before compiling; they are not lowercased.

redact.about: Redaction is context-first (red team: a checksum gate lowers recall on ASR output, because a misheard digit fails the checksum and the number leaks). Context near a digit run masks it; with no context, a checksum (Luhn for 13-19 digits, Verhoeff for 12) raises confidence enough to mask. 10-digit Indian phone numbers are not masked unless an OTP/PIN context sits next to them.

T-L3.about: Drops facts whose purpose tag is not allowed for the call category, and facts tagged service/logistics/identity whose text reads as an offer on a service or transactional call (a mis-tag).

T-L4.about: Refuse any link or bare domain in the config (outside brand.verifiedDomains itself) whose host is not a verified domain or its subdomain. Email addresses are not links. Link shorteners are never verified.

links.about: A host is accepted when it equals a verified domain or ends with '.' + a verified domain. Spoken forms ('dot com') are rewritten to '.com' before matching.
